items.title: Vampire Survivors studio poncle has teamed with Auroch Digital on Warhammer Survivors, and it lands on Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass on day one, 10 November
items.summary: Warhammer Survivors, from Auroch Digital with Vampire Survivors studio poncle, hits Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass on day one on 10 November 2026.
items.content:
**Vampire Survivors studio poncle has teamed with Auroch Digital on Warhammer Survivors, and it lands on Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass on day one, 10 November**

Warhammer Survivors launches on 10 November 2026 and arrives on Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass the same day, according to the November 2026 Game Pass wave one post published on Xbox Wire on 3 November 2026 by Megan Spurr.

The listing marks the title “Available on day one with XBOX Game Pass!”

Xbox Wire calls it “an officially licensed game from Auroch Digital in partnership with” the “Vampire Survivors developers, poncle”. Auroch Digital is the studio the entry credits the game to. poncle, written in lower case by Xbox Wire, is named there as the Vampire Survivors developers. The post does not say how the work is split between the two studios.

The entry sells the game on its action, promising players can “Unleash devastating barrages of bullets, blades and magic in the addictive bullet-heaven action of Warhammer Survivors”.

On the setting, the post says players will “Experience Warhammer’s epic champions, enemy factions, weapons and more, meticulously handcrafted in animated pixel glory”.

No price appears anywhere in the post, for Warhammer Survivors or for any other title in the wave. The entries give tiers, platforms, dates and a short description, with nothing on cost.

Warhammer Survivors is not the only entry in this wave connected to Vampire Survivors. Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors was listed for 4 November on Cloud, Xbox Series X|S, Handheld and PC, described as a game “From the creators of Vampire Survivors” that “turns the thrill of Survivors into a hyper turn based, rogue-lite card driven blobber”. The post does not name poncle on that entry.

That entry is listed as “Now with Game Pass Premium; joining Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass”.

Warhammer Survivors is listed for Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass. Game Pass Premium and Game Pass Essential do not appear on its entry.

That distinction is visible across the wave. Thronefall, dated 11 November, and John Carpenter’s Toxic Commando, dated 12 November, are each listed for Game Pass Ultimate, Game Pass Premium and PC Game Pass. Pit of Goblin, already available, carries the same three tiers.

The platforms given for Warhammer Survivors are Cloud, Xbox Series X|S, Handheld and PC. A footnote at the end of the post defines the last of those: “Games with a ‘Handheld’ designation represent those that are optimized for handheld play.” Among the other November titles, Vampire Crawlers, Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School, Thronefall and Aphelion carry the same tag.

Two titles appear under Available Today. Football Manager 27 is on PC through Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass. Pit of Goblin, an online co-op horror game in which players “play as a scrappy goblin, scavenging dungeons, dodging traps, and fleeing monsters”, is on Cloud, Xbox Series X|S and PC.

Void/Breaker was listed for 4 November on Cloud, Xbox Series X|S and PC, launching in what the post calls “its 1.0 full release”. The entry adds that it is “Now available on XBOX Series X|S and Cloud Gaming!”

items.title: Wielders of the Essence Review – Small but strong
Football Manager, Warhammer Survivors and More Land on Xbox Game Pass Soon
items.summary: Xbox Game Pass Essential subscribers get a few more games this month, too.
items.content:
Xbox Game Pass Essential subscribers get a few more games this month, too.

Microsoft Microsoft on Tuesday announced the games it’s adding to its Xbox Game Pass service in the first half of November. Grand Theft Auto 6 is the most anticipated game of the year, which Rockstar Games will release on Nov. 19, so GTA 6 may consume your playtime from then on. But that still leaves plenty of time to give these upcoming Game Pass titles a shot. I know I’m particularly excited about Warhammer Survivors. I really enjoyed Vampire Survivors, and I can’t wait to play as Fo’Baran , the chaplain of my beloved Salamanders from Warhammer 40K.

Xbox Game Pass , a CNET Editors’ Choice award winner, offers a wide selection of games you can play on your Xbox Series X , Xbox Series S, Xbox One and PC or mobile device for as little as $10 per month . With a higher-tier Game Pass Ultimate subscription ( $23 per month ), you can access hundreds of games, including new ones on release day, each month.

Here are all the games Microsoft is adding to Xbox Game Pass soon.

Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass subscribers can play on Nov. 5.

Class is back in session in this puzzle game. This sequel to the award-winning Escape Academy brings you more puzzles to solve and a series-first open-world format. That makes the campus one big puzzle room filled with secrets, traps and more. If you get stuck, you can always chill with your friends and enjoy student life away from the classroom. The choice is yours.

Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass subscribers can play on Nov. 10.

Poncle, the creator of the indie hit Vampire Survivors, teamed up with Auroch Digital to let you bring your favorite Warhammer primarchs and champions into bullet-heaven action. Each character has their own special ability to help you defeat waves of enemies. Every stage is a new arena full of enemies and secrets to uncover. So grab your chainsword and whirlwind axes, because there are pixelated enemies to destroy.

Get ready for the most immersive matchday experience yet in the latest installment of the long-running Football Manager series. You’ll shape your club and define your team’s style, and you can get lost in the wider football universe thanks to smart news and events that mirror the drama of the football calendar.

While Xbox is bringing those titles to Game Pass soon, it’s also adding these games to the service in the first half of November, too.

Game Pass Essential costs $10 a month and offers access to a relatively small library of games compared with Game Pass Premium and Ultimate. While Microsoft doesn’t regularly add many games to Essential’s library, it’s adding these eight titles to this Game Pass tier on Nov. 15.

While Microsoft is adding several games to Game Pass soon, it’s also removing over a dozen games on Nov. 15. So you’ll have to buy these games separately if you still need to complete your main campaign or any side quests after they’re removed.

For more, here’s our Xbox Game Pass review and other titles you can play on the service . You can also read our recent review of the Xbox Nano Controller .

items.title: Xbox Game Pass: First Wave of Games Coming in November 2026 Revealed
Xbox Game Pass November 2026: Warhammer Survivors and the day-one wave skip Premium
items.summary: Microsoft's first November wave for Xbox Game Pass is heavy on launch-day releases, but every one of them sits in Ultimate and PC Game Pass. Premium gets a diff
items.content:
Add us on Google Every month Microsoft publishes its Xbox Game Pass list, and every month the coverage counts the games. November’s first wave counts well: a stack of new releases arriving on the same day they go on sale, packed into the first half of the month. What the roundups skip is the small print next to each title, the line that says which subscription it belongs to. Read those labels and November stops being one lineup. It becomes three, sorted by what a subscriber pays.

The launch-day games, the part of the list that sells the service, go to two plans only: Game Pass Ultimate, which covers console, cloud and PC, and PC Game Pass. Premium, the middle plan on console, gets a different shelf of games, some of them worth playing, none of them new on launch day. That split is the mechanism Microsoft rebuilt Game Pass around, and this month shows it more plainly than most.

Xbox Wire’s November post flags six entries as “available on day one”: Football Manager 27 on PC, out today; Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School on November 5; the console edition of Football Manager 27, Warhammer Survivors and Tanuki: Pon’s Summer, all on November 10; and Hope in the City on November 11. Each one carries the same two labels, Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass. Not one carries Premium.

Warhammer Survivors is the obvious headliner. It is an officially licensed game from Auroch Digital, made in partnership with poncle, the developer of Vampire Survivors; GameSpot sums it up as Vampire Survivors with a grimdark spin. Escape Academy 2, which Microsoft bills as the first open-world escape room game, adds online and local two-player co-op. Hope in the City is a mystery adventure about a teenager who comes home to a ransacked apartment and two missing parents, set, as GameSpot notes, in the seedy underbelly of Shenyang.

Premium’s share of the wave is eight games. Pit of Goblin, an online horror co-op game, reaches its full release today after an early-access run that GameSpot dates to 2024. Void/Breaker, a roguelite shooter, arrives in its 1.0 version. Then come Firefighting Simulator: Ignite, the small strategy game Thronefall, John Carpenter ‘s Toxic Commando, a four-player co-op zombie shooter, and Paw Patrol: Dino World. Two more are marked “now with Game Pass Premium”: Vampire Crawlers, from the creators of Vampire Survivors, and Aphelion, the sci-fi adventure Don’t Nod made in partnership with the European Space Agency.

The list has real quality in it, and a ceiling over it. The newest, most marketed releases of the month are on the other side of an upgrade, and Microsoft’s own post says so in the labels rather than in the headline.

Since Microsoft’s April price cut, Premium costs $14.99 a month in the US and Ultimate $22.99, according to Pure Xbox’s breakdown of the new prices. In the UK the gap is £10.99 against £16.99; in the eurozone, €12.99 against €20.99. On a console, that difference is what a launch-day game costs.

PC Game Pass shows how deliberate the line is. At $13.99 it is a dollar cheaper than Premium, and it gets all six day-one entries, because every one of them is listed for PC. A PC player pays less than a Premium console player and receives the launches the console player has to upgrade for. In practice Game Pass works as three products, and the newest games are the lever that moves people up the ladder.

The bottom rung is filling with older games. Essential, the $9.99 plan, adds eight titles on November 15: Banjo-Kazooie, Banjo-Tooie, Banjo-Kazooie: Nuts & Bolts, Gears of War: Judgment, Halo: Spartan Assault, Perfect Dark, Viva Piñata and Viva Piñata: TIP. Back catalogue at the bottom, new releases at the top.

The same day, the outgoing wave leaves. Xbox Wire lists thirteen titles departing on November 15, among them Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2, Wreckfest, 1000xResist, Moonlighter and GoldenEye 007. GameSpot and Pure Xbox count fourteen because they add Football Manager 26, which Pure Xbox says leaves on November 10, the day Football Manager 27 arrives on console. One edition hands over to the next. Most departing games are discounted by at least 20% until they go, per Pure Xbox, and GameSpot reports a second batch of exits on November 30.

The calendar is just as easy to read. GameSpot observes, drily, that the month is front-loaded with releases before November 19, the date Grand Theft Auto VI launches. Microsoft’s wave stops on November 17. GTA VI is not part of it; GameSpot’s buying guide lists the standard edition at $80.

On November 15, GoldenEye 007 leaves Game Pass on the same day Perfect Dark joins Essential, the cheapest plan. That is the whole ladder in a single day: one old shooter walks out, another walks in at the bottom, and the new games stay at the top for whoever pays for them.

He's a Portland, Oregon–based journalist known for covering gaming, the outdoors, national parks, tech, food, and internet culture. He has written for a range of publications including Outside Magazine , Boston Magazine , Vice , the Seattle Times and Digital Trends. News November 2026 additions include a new co-op adventure, a kingdom-building game, and a familiar fantasy universe

The latest announcement includes everything from a new co-op escape room adventure to a minimalist kingdom-building strategy game and a bullet-heaven spin-off set in the Warhammer universe .

Among the biggest additions are Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School , Thronefall , and Warhammer Survivors , with all three arriving before the middle of November. Here's what to know about these games and everything else coming to Xbox Game Pass.

One of the biggest additions is Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School , the sequel to Coin Crew Games' 2022 puzzle adventure. Arriving Nov. 5, the game expands the escape room formula into an open-world experience , with online and local two-player co-op allowing friends to explore a school campus and solve puzzles together.

Another notable addition is Warhammer Survivors , an officially licensed bullet-heaven game developed by Auroch Digital in partnership with Vampire Survivors creator poncle. Launching Nov. 10, it brings Warhammer champions, enemy factions, and weapons into the survival formula, with players unleashing barrages of bullets, blades, and magic.

The first wave of new Game Pass games for November has been revealed today, and it includes Football Manager 27, Warhammer Survivors, and three other games coming to the service on day one. The Xbox team also announced new additions to the Game Pass Essential library, with eight new games coming on November 15.

Warhammer Survivors is one of the main highlights of this first Game Pass wave. It’s a fast-paced roguelite developed in partnership with Poncle, the studio behind Vampire Survivors and Vampire Crawlers. It will be coming to Game Pass on November 10 along with the console version of Football Manager 2027.

Xbox Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass subscribers will also get to play the escape room game Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School on day one in November. The adventure games Tanuki: Pon’s Summer, Hope in the City, and the strategy game Thronefall complete the list of new day-one games.

You can find the full list of new Game Pass Games below:

As I mentioned earlier, the Game Pass Essential library will add eight new titles on November 8: The list includes Rare’s three Xbox 360 Banjo games, the two Viva Piñata games, Perfect Dark, Gears of War: Judgment, and Halo: Spartan Assault.

Lastly, 13 games will be removed from the Game Pass library on November 15, including Rare’s Goldeneye 007, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2, Moonlighter, Relic Hunters Legend, Total Chaos, Winter Burrow, and Wreckfest. As usual, Game Pass members can purchase them at a 20% discount before they leave the service.

items.summary: Microsoft has announced 13 more games coming to Xbox Game Pass Ultimate, Standard, PC, and Cloud.The list of games [...]
items.content:
Microsoft has announced 13 more games coming to Xbox Game Pass Ultimate, Standard, PC, and Cloud.

The list of games includes Football Manager 27, Football Manager 2027 Console, Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors, Void/Breaker, Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School, Firefighting Simulator: Ignite, MySims Cozy Bundle, Warhammer Survivors, Tanuki: Pon’s Summer, Hope in the City, Thronefall, John Carpenter’s Toxic Commando, Aphelion, and Paw Patrol: Dino World .

Read all the latest Xbox Game Pass information below:

Football Manager 27 (PC) Game Pass Ultimate, PC Game Pass

Available on day one with XBOX Game Pass! Flow from the tactics board to the touchline in Football Manager 27 as foundations evolve to deliver greater control, smoother discovery and a more enticing football world.

Pit of Goblin (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, and PC) Game Pass Ultimate, Game Pass Premium, PC Game Pass

In this online horror co-op, you play as a scrappy goblin, scavenging dungeons, dodging traps, and fleeing monsters to feed the Goblin King-Queen. Team up with goblin pals, or go rogue, as you dive deep and cause chaos! Fail to feed them, and you might be the next meal!

Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, Handheld, and PC) – November 4 Now with Game Pass Premium; joining Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass

From the creators of Vampire Survivors , Vampire Crawlers turns the thrill of Survivors into a hyper turn based, rogue-lite card driven blobber. Build busted decks, explore familiar dungeons, and unleash world ending combos. Either take your time and be tactical or play turns as fast as you humanly can: The outcome is always accurate!

Void/Breaker (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, and PC) – November 4 Game Pass Ultimate, Game Pass Premium, PC Game Pass

Now available on XBOX Series X|S and Cloud Gaming! Launching in its 1.0 full release, Void/Breaker is an adrenaline-fueled roguelite FPS where you must fight to break free from an endless cycle driven by a hostile AI. Battle relentless machines, craft infinite weapon variants via deep gun modding, and forge deadly synergies to tear down the simulation and destroy everything in your path.

Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, Handheld, and PC) – November 5 Game Pass Ultimate, PC Game Pass

Available on day one with XBOX Game Pass! Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School evolves the escape room format into a whole new genre: This is the first open world escape room game! Featuring online and local two player co-op.

Firefighting Simulator: Ignite (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, and PC) – November 5 Game Pass Ultimate, Game Pass Premium, and PC Game Pass

items.title: Vampire Survivors meets Heroes of Might and Magic in New Fantasy Strategy Game 'Heroes Never Die'
items.summary: If you've ever wondered what a fusion of Vampire Survivors and Heroes of Might and Magic would look like, then Heroes Never Die might be the game for you. It's a newly announced fantasy strategy game from developer Ludogram that "aims to take the best of the survival formula and fuse it with more tactical decisions, real-time army building, and powerful fantasy heroes." It will be released in 2027 for PC.
items.content:
If you've ever wondered what a fusion of Vampire Survivors and Heroes of Might and Magic would look like, then Heroes Never Die might be the game for you. It's a newly announced fantasy strategy game from developer Ludogram that "aims to take the best of the survival formula and fuse it with more tactical decisions, real-time army building, and powerful fantasy heroes." It will be released in 2027 for PC.

In Heroes Never Die, you'll choose your titular hero – there are over 20 in the lineup – and battle not just monster hordes but also rival heroes. Each hero has their own skills, but no matter who you pick, you'll seek to upgrade your town by gathering resources and fighting foes. There are also four factions and over 60 different units, with the developers promising that no two runs will be alike.

“We’re delighted to finally announce Heroes Never Die, a project we’ve been working on in the shadows for a couple of years”, said creative director Edouard Gaudel. “We cannot wait to see our first players fighting hordes of monsters, and evolving their armies while meeting our heroes. Don’t forget to join our upcoming Playtest!”

If you're interested, you can sign up for the private playtest and/or wishlist Heroes Never Die on Steam .

Ryan McCaffrey is IGN's executive editor of previews and host of IGN's weekly Xbox show, Podcast Unlocked , and a co-host of Next-Gen Console Watch . He's a North Jersey guy, so it's "Taylor ham," not "pork roll." Debate it with him on Twitter at @DMC_Ryan .

items.title: Bullet Heaven Games: auto-shooters, reverse bullet hells, and games like Vampire Survivors
items.summary: Games like Vampire Survivors, including: Picayune Dreams, Brotato, Deep Rock Galactic: Survivors, Soulstone Survivors, and The Spell Brigade.
items.content:
Welcome, Dear Reader, to Rogueliker’s guide to the best bullet heaven games, reverse bullet hells, auto-shooters, and survivors-likes – that is, these are the best games like Vampire Survivors.

Which brings us neatly to our starting point: Vampire Survivors, a game that has become something of a cultural phenomenon. The game had a growing audience even before Phil Spencer (the man in charge of Xbox) revealed that he had been playing it obsessively. Spencer’s public confession, however, put the game on millions of radars, and Poncle’s auto-shooter hasn’t looked back since.

Not only has Vampire Survivors continued to enjoy success, but it has also inspired a tidal wave of reverent auto-shooters, cheeky clones, and clever copycats. Simply put: if you like Poncle’s so-called bullet heaven game, you are currently being well served with new offerings.

Because this burgeoning sub-genre of gaming continues to grow, and considering the fact that I’ve played both Vampire Survivors and a decent number of similarly structured action-roguelites, I figured it was time to put together a feature that highlighted a number of auto-shooters. Now, anyone who is eager for more can easily get started on something new.

Before that, if you’d like a deeper dive into the finest games that the wider genre has to offer, check out our guide to the best roguelikes, roguelites, and roguelike-likes.

This one gets a section all to itself. I mean, it’s the reason that we’re all here, isn’t it? Vampire Survivors is a very personal recommendation from me; I played the game A LOT after discovering it. In fact, it was the game I played after completing Hades, and after spending hundreds of hours with both, and after seeing how popular these games were, I figured that making Rogueliker was worth a shot.

I’ve been a big fan of roguelikes, roguelites, and I think also games with permadeath and deep, interlocking systems for a while. Vampire Survivors delivers so much on that final front, chiefly via its wealth of playable characters, each one tuned slightly differently and with their own starting weapons. There are also loads of levels to unlock and explore, and each one is riddled with secrets to discover.

What I love the most about Vampire Survivors is the way the game feels to play. After intense speed runs with Zagreus in Hades, it was nice to just stroll around whacking things with a whip/sword/bird strike and making an interesting decision every few minutes. The game’s one-stick controls are so intuitive and the gameplay so straightforward, it’s so easy to fall for its considerable charms.

Once that happens to you, you’re done for because there’s so much game here just waiting for you to explore. What’s more, it’s a generous game with a low starting cost and reasonably priced DLC expansions. Speaking of expansions, I mentioned that the game was a “cultural phenomenon” up top, and that wasn’t hyperbole, as Vampire Survivors’ expansions include Among Us and Contra, plus the game itself has been appearing in other places, including a favourite game of mine, Balatro .

If you’re done with Vampire Survivors but want more of that sweet reverse bullet hell gameplay, your next port of call might well be Picayune Dreams.

This bold, surreal space shooter is undoubtedly inspired by Vampire Survivors, but to the credit of the game’s designers, they’ve kept a similar spirit but expressed it very differently. For starters, you can take control of the action more directly with the auto-shooter element being a toggleable option, and that makes a difference.

Enemies drop numbers when they perish, and bigger numbers will help you level more quickly. There’s transmogrification, which means you can see the items as they’re added to your avatar. Enemy designs are surreal, and the whole thing feels much more thematically independent than most other auto-shooters. The story is enigmatic and full of mystery. Finally, there are boss battles where the action descends into bullet hell; a crowning twist that makes Picayune Dreams one of the best games in the genre.

My third highlight is Brotato, a game that offers a similar-yet-very-different experience from the above top picks. This is a very silly game that doesn’t take itself too seriously, yet it also delivers a fun and constantly rewarding experience.

The key differentiator here is the tightly controlled arenas. Vampire Survivors has vast, sprawling levels, and Picayune Dreams has you floating around in the vastness of space, but Brotato keeps the action on a much tighter leash; you can only roam around a small square here. Instead of exploration, the focus is more on staying nimble and moving quickly and, of course, taking down your enemies.

items.content:
Hi everyone!

The stable version of VS has been updated to 1.16.111

Contains several fixes: - Fixes for online desyncs - Fixed BGM hiccups - Fixed Argent Flow not reducing enemy defenses - Fixed common Gifts drop rates (Pearl Magatama, Velvet Dodecahedron) - Fixed QuickStart getting stuck on the same few setups on late game save files - Fixed Survarots not working properly if unlocked via spells - Fixed prices on Bloodmoon evos - Fixed Emerald and Joker Disks sometimes not unlocking stages - Fixed some evos not always registering for unlocking Bloodmoon characters - Fixed some weapons not getting cleaned up properly when removed (eg. Forbidden Siren) - Fixed LunarBight not slowing enemies down - Fixed some weapons not firing properly at very low cooldown. - Fixed several achievements and secrets not working online. - Performance improvements for late-game frame drops - Reduced Knockback received by Bloodmoon bosses - Shenanigans to buff Vicious Hunger gold yield to try to get close to the pre-collision-fix values The patch is also being rolled out to other platforms. The next content update of Vampire Survivors is still several weeks away, but in the meantime the new content will be available for preview in the public-beta branch (on PC). We're advertising this public-beta in particular because it contains a major update to the engine version (or we wouldn't be able to publish patches on most platforms after October) and online capabilities, so it would be great to get more players than usual to try it out. The public-beta currently contains about a lot of the content scheduled for version 1.17, so there's plenty to fiddle with. Save data carries over back-and-forth safely. After the darkness of Legacy of the Bloodmoon, it's time for some levity: please come have fun at...

- 1 new character - 2 new weapons & evolutions - 2 new Darkanas - 1 incredibly useless relic - Sefi Rotto, the winner of the Lucca Comics ARG!

🔴 Ode to Castlevania Soundtrack:

48 bonus tracks added to the VS ost

For the 40th anniversary of the Castlevania series, we teamed up with Konami once again, and after months of working together on the licensing, we're able to add the full Ode to Castlevania soundtrack, all 48 tracks, to the VS Soundtrack on Steam! It comes at no extra cost, and if you already own the OST, the update should already be in your download queue. Please note that this is a time-limited licensing deal, so at some point in the future we may not be able to renew it and would have to remove the 48 bonus tracks. https://store.steampowered.com/app/2169090/Vampire_Survivors_Soundtrack/ Unfortunately we couldn't get the licensing rights to put the music tracks on streaming services as requested by many :( They are available on Youtube, at least .

🔴 Custom Characters

In case you missed the previous news about Custom Characters, we've started adding Steam Workshop support, starting with, well, custom characters! Please join the Discord or check the official wiki if you're interested in trying them out locally before we officially open the Steam Workshop.

🔴 Steam Achievements

Thanks to a new Steam feature, we'll finally be able to separate main game achievements from DLC ones, without ruining game completion rates. We'll be doing a lot of tidying up before the end of the year, together with the full release of v1.17

🟡 Warhammer Survivors by Auroch Digital

arrives on November 10th

Our friends at Auroch Digital, makers of the fantastic Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun, have been tinkering with the VS engine to bring the VS experience to Warhammer fans: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3669620/Warhammer_Survivors/ You can try the demo right now! (Please note that progress doesn't carry over to the full game)

🔵 Vampire Crawlers

new content and mobile release

Here’s the latest from Vampire Crawlers:
  • Now available on iOS and Android![/*]
  • The Death Parade content update is out now[/*]
  • Two new OST tracks (“Barely Staying Alive - Crawling” and “Barely Staying Alive - Turbo”)[/*]
  • The full soundtrack is also now on Spotify[/*]
  • And as of today, we’re part of a limited-time charity bundle raising money to support UNICEF’s work for children around the world.[/*]
Thank you and see you soon in public-beta or on the next Steam news! - Luca

items.summary: 🔴Legacy of the Bloodmoon Hi everyone! Our darkest expansion for Vampire Survivors is out now and at a special price: one money! (or as low as we could go, depending on regional currency). Yes, the finance team wants to kill me. https://sto
items.content:
🔴Legacy of the Bloodmoon

Hi everyone! Our darkest expansion for Vampire Survivors is out now and at a special price: one money! (or as low as we could go, depending on regional currency). Yes, the finance team wants to kill me. https://store.steampowered.com/app/4781330/Vampire_Survivors_Legacy_of_the_Bloodmoon/ This expansion pack follows Clan Bloodmoon as they retrace the pilgrimage of Saint Baal’Thasar, in search of a paradise lit by (you guessed it) a bright red moon. There is also an ancient manor that may or may not hide the secret of immortality. Legacy of the Bloodmoon contains:
  • 12 new villains friendly characters
  • 16+ new weapons and evolutions, including a FireBall
  • 11 savage new music tracks
  • 1 new adventure
  • 1 new very large stage

Other platforms

All platforms will be on stable version 1.16.100 or higher. Version 1.16.105, which contains performance improvements and a fix to an ability for Baal'Thasar, should arrive on Android and Nintendo Switch by the end of next week.

🔴Legacy of the Moonspell

But that's not all! Our very first expansion, Legacy of the Moonspell, is also getting extra content and, if you don't already own it, it is also at a special price: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2230760/Vampire_Survivors_Legacy_of_the_Moonspell/ - 5 extra weapons - 4 extra characters - 1 extra music track - buffs to the original cast of characters

🔴Version 1.16.100

The game has been updated to version 1.16.100 to handle the new content, but also to add performance and QOL improvements: - Banish: after banishing an item, you can keep using the LevelUp menu. - Quickstart: it now tries to pick a character and/or stage that is linked to a missing unlock - Special passives buff (Operation Guns, Emergency Meeting): they can now be found in ArmaDios and as a LevelUp option whenever they'd normally be available, and even if the player has reached the passive limit. - Reworked several main framework features to improve CPU and memory usage across the board - Fixed some Drowners not spawning - Fixed Gorgeous Moon and Big Fuzzy Fist missing sprites - Fixed some weapons glitching textures when paired with other weapons (eg. Fleuret) - Fixed damage numbers glitching at low FPS and improved their perfomance - Fixed stuttering when the stage minutes change - Fixed purchase of MAX Golden Eggs - Fixed Luck bonus glitching on Chula-Reh and Henry - Ongoing work to improve visibility of interactable objects/layers You can find the rest of the patchnotes since version 1.15.100 here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1794680/discussions/0/583931105981294494/

🔴Platform achievements

We're trying once again to find a way to add achievements without affecting the completion rate for the main game, but we don't know if it will be possible. Regardless, new Steam achievements for the base game, Moonspell, and Bloodmoon will be added in patch 1.17, scheduled to release before the end of the year. Once the achievements are published, they'll unlock automatically if you have already obtained them in game, so nothing is lost.

🔴VS Soundtrack

The soundtrack will be updated in a few days with the missing tracks from the base game, Moonspell, and Bloodmoon! Legacy of the Bloodmoon ended up having 11 music tracks instead of 8, but by now I think we're all pretty used to content creep 🤷‍♂️ Please remember that due to the legal insanities of music licensing, we are not allowed to distribute tracks from Operation Guns, Ode to Castlevania, or Emerald Diorama. But we're still trying... Well, that's enough of the doom and gloom of Bloodmoon for me, need a nice sunny place to take a break 😎 Let's see what the options are: 🩻- darkest depths of Moongolow -> Vampire Crawlers 1.1 👻- Tokyo overrun by cursed spirits -> JJKRS 1.0 ☠️- -> top secret - NDA - 0.1 ⛱️- Biggus Diccus Theme Park -> Vampire Survivors 1.17 Looks like there's a clear winner! Thank you and see you in the next patch! ⛱️ - Luca

items.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton
items.summary: Hi everyone, we have a lot happening around new games and Vampire Survivors, so here's a gigantic news post! 🟣- Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton 🔴- Vampire Survivors 1.15 🔴- Legacy of the Bloodmoon teasers 🔴- Legacy of the Moonspell in
items.content:
Hi everyone, we have a lot happening around new games and Vampire Survivors, so here's a gigantic news post! 🟣- Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton 🔴- Vampire Survivors 1.15 🔴- Legacy of the Bloodmoon teasers 🔴- Legacy of the Moonspell info 🔴- Workshop Support for Vampire Survivors 🔴- ARG and Character Community Challenge winners 🔴- Vampire Survivors Comics 🔵- Vampire Crawlers updates 🟢- PoncleUp

🟣 Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton

A few days back we announced Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton in collaboration with Shueisha Games! Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton is a game like Vampire Survivors, but with a twist: you'll be able to play an 8-player survivors royale PvPvE mode! Some in-game names and terminology are still in development and may be subject to change. While every player plays in their own world, you accumulate points by defeating curses and sorcerers, and with every 100 points accumulated you get to choose a Rule Change that can affect everyone's game. Some Rule Changes are INSANE, but for now we'll just reveal the simple ones you can see in the trailer (silence, slow, steal points...). But Rule Changes aren't the only way to interact with other players. Introducing a world first, mind blowing, unbelievable game mechanic: PRESS A BUTTON. While you move your auto-attacking character, your special attack also builds up. By PRESSING A BUTTON when the special attack is ready, you get to unleash your character's Special Attack, or, if that character can, a DOMAIN EXPANSION! Other players can be caught in the effect of your Domain or Special Attack, so you have to keep an eye on other players' position and special-bar status. A very important aspect of the 8-players mode is the Live Match Status Feed (working name). This big chunk of UI on the left side of the screen constantly updates in real time, acting not only as a scoreboard, but also sending out warnings and all kind of information about what the other players are up to. At the end of the 15 minutes battle royale, the 2 players with the most points will face one another in a 19 seconds duel. Despite the online focus, Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton is a game you can also play alone, in a mission-based mode, just like Vampire Survivors. If you don't ever want to go online, you'll still be able to play the 8-players battle royale mode against bots. This is a game you buy once and can play anytime. We'll keep supporting the game after launch, with our usual style of content updates. So forget about gatcha elements or a forever-evolving PvP meta keeping your time and wallet hostages: our focus here are fun and affordability. Apologies if you had enough of this wall of text, but I kepty mouth shut for almost two years and I haven't even got to the technical bits yet! Yes, the game runs on the Vampire Survivors - First Survivaton framework, so you can expect that same familiar experience playing it, but we had to do several unique tweaks for Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble Survivaton. Other than the obvious, completely new networking for the gameplay and Live Match Status Feed, we have doubled the resolution at which the game runs. That allowed us to completely rebuild the whole VFX pipeline so that we could re-create the distinctive look of Curse Energy and the changes the whole stage depending on activated Domain Expansions or Special Attacks. Another reason to double the resolution was to properly display the UI (that has been completely reworked at framework level) and the Live Match Status Feed, that is capable of also streaming gameplay snippets from other online players. You'll see a lot of other tweaks, like the fact that characters look different if they are seen from the left or from the right, a "default attack" per character that triggers without any weapon, or walls that are actually solid to name a few. Then there are other changes that won't be noticeable until you get to play the game. For example, while we are going by the same content-unlock-philosophy as Vampire Survivors, we are completely reworking the progression in the various game modes and also per-character, so that every game mode will feel fresh even to VS veterans. That's all for now, I hope you have enjoyed the trailer; my favourite part was that bit were Gojo takes a walk.

🔴 Vampire Survivors 1.15 available on all platforms

- Nintendo Switch 1 and 2 - Android - iOS & Apple Arcade - PS4 and PS5 - Xbox - EGS In the following weeks there will be small updates quite often on all platforms to bring them all on the same version, because all platforms have the same content, but not the same bugfixes and tweaks. Please join the Discord or keep an eye on the Updates version of the wiki if you're interested in knowing the fixes in each update (I won't spam Steam News every week for small tweaks).

🔴 New Moonspell Content spoilers

When we'll launch Legacy of the Bloodmoon, we'll also update the contents of Legacy of the Moonspell. It will get 7 new unlocks, that will deliver:

  • 4 new weapons: LunarMight, LunarSight, LunarBight, and LunarFlight [/*]
  • 1 Special Evolution: Argent Flow [/*]
  • 1 new passive Weapon: Pearl Magatama [/*]
  • 4 new characters [/*]
  • 1 new music track [/*]
  • some buffs to the original cast of characters: [/*]
- Menya Moonspell gets Overheal +16: activates her starting weapon. - Babi-Onna gets Overheal +16: gains a temporary bonus to MoveSpeed (that also means she attacks faster). - Megalo Menya Moonspell gets Overheal +16: activates her first weapon. - Megalo Syuuto Moonspell gets Overheal +16: equipped Blood weapons gain extra damage. - McCoy-Oni gets Overheal +16: gains a Reroll. - Gav'Et-Oni gets \.This will be a free update, in fact last month we have actually dropped the price of Legacy of the Moonspell to balance out a bit the cost/content ratio of the various expansions.

🔴 Bloodmoon character tease

Legacy of the Bloodmoon is almost complete and we will be able to start testing and submissions soon! That means we'll have an actual release date soon too. In the meantime, here's a Character Spotlight video about Malice Bloodmoon:

🔴 ARG and Community Character Competition winners

Congratulations to the trio of winners of the Lucca Comics ARG: Jenoss, Miryel, Siming, and GIU_LLS (:poemg:?), and to DissonantSynth for winning the Community Challenge! We're finally getting into the design stage of the characters, with a first implementation that will soon be shared with the winners, behind the scenes, to start iterating together on gameplay mechanics. You can expect a few surprises and little extras about them when they'll make their appearance in the game! Baron Husker and Sefi Rotto (:poemg:?) will come alive in a later update, v1.17

🔴 First steps for Steam Workshop support

Instead of waiting the conclusion of the current cycles of updates for Vampire Survivors as originally planned, we will develop modding support over time, one feature at a time. Feature 1 will be about adding CUSTOM (private/local) and WORKSHOP (public/Steam Workshop) characters! Please join the Discord or use the public-beta forum if you're interested in trying out custom characters before they go live on the main branch, in a future update (currently aiming for v1.17)

🔴 Vampire Survivors Comics

Vampire Survivor is getting comics! We've been working with Titan Comics on a 4-issue series, written by David Hazan and illustrated by Jimm Kucaj, with the first issue coming out this September, available in 3 cover variants. Some familiar Vampire Survivors will go through Mad Forest, Inlaid Library, Dairy Plant, and a few other places, and there might even be some lore in there. Issue #1 is available to pre-order from your local comic shop or from Forbidden Planet if you're in the UK / EU. You can find out more about the comics on the Titan Comics website.

🔵 Vampire Crawlers: first QOL update

Our first update to Vampire Crawlers add an Endless mode and several QOL improvements! You can find more details, the strategy behind future updates, and some content spoilers in the Steam News here.

🟢 Countup to the next announcement

Look, we're doing a lot of stuff across several small teams. I'm always happy to write the Steam News but I cannot bombard your feed with everything we're doing. Also took me something like 3 weeks to set this all up. So if you'd like to hear about what we're doing a bit more often, then please visit poncleup.com to see a recap or subscribe to our newsletter. It's a countup instead of a countdown because, as you might have noticed, we're release-date-averse and have no idea ourselves when we'll drop something new 🤷‍♂️ Just know that the newsletters are written by the marketing team :vsskull: Alright, I'm done with work, time to go back having fun on my secret project. Thank you everyone, I'll leave you in the self-proclaimed capable hands of the marketing team! - Luca

items.title: Vampire Survivors: Legacy of the Bloodmoon is coming this summer!
items.summary: Hi everyone! As anticipated several months ago, we’ve been working on several core systems of VS to be able to keep making more content, increase stability, and improve performance. It’s been a while so we have quite a few things to cover t
items.content:
Hi everyone! As anticipated several months ago, we’ve been working on several core systems of VS to be able to keep making more content, increase stability, and improve performance. It’s been a while so we have quite a few things to cover today: - a new expansion for VS - a new update - a new poncle team in Japan - the very sensible reason why Vampire Survivors has a sub-title now 🤷‍♂️

Vampire Survivors Update 1.15 (The Wet One) is out now on Steam!

You can find all details about 1.15 below, now here’s a stupid summer trailer about it:

Major QOL improvements

  • Multiple Save Slots (about time!)
  • Character Setup panel for skins, egg selection, etc…
  • Content filters in Character Selection and Unlocks menu
  • Stability improvements for late game and low-end platforms
  • Reduced loading times (more noticeable on other platforms than PC)

New content

  • 1 New Stage: The Lycaeum
  • 2 New Characters
  • either 2 or 10 new weapons 🤷‍♂️
  • 3 New Darkanas
  • 1 New Music Track
  • 3 new Relics, of which 1 Secret rather than Unlockable

Other tweaks and features

  • "Random LevelUp" can now be toggled during a run if it is already unlocked on the Stage menu
  • Added option to Unbanish a weapon when picking it up from the stage
  • Buffed a few weapons like Magi-Stone and Mille Bolle Blu
  • Rendering fixes for a few weapons, including birds, Prismatic Missile, Runetracer…
Patch 1.15 will be released on all other platforms a bit later, by the end of the month, due to platform-specific optimizations and differences in save slots management. On the bright side, we will also be releasing a Nintendo Switch 2 version, with better performance and mouse support!

Vampire Survivors: Legacy of the Bloodmoon is coming Summer 2026

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4781330/Vampire_Survivors_Legacy_of_the_Bloodmoon/ Vampire Survivors: Legacy of the Bloodmoon is our “accidental” next expansion and the evil twin to Legacy of the Moonspell. The original plan was just to make a little content update to Legacy of the Moonspell. Since it’s the first and smallest VS expansion, it felt right to try to balance its value a little. Needless to say, ideas started to flow and everything spiraled into a much bigger project. I’m not sure I’ll ever learn at this stage. In the end, Legacy of the Moonspell will be getting its content buff (7 new unlocks) and Legacy of the Bloodmoon will live a life of its own. This expansion pack follows Clan Bloodmoon as they retrace the pilgrimage of Saint Baal’Thasar, in search of a paradise lit by (you guessed it) a bright red moon. There is also an ancient manor that may or may not hide the secret of immortality. Legacy of the Bloodmoon will contain:
  • 12 new villains friendly characters
  • 16+ new weapons and evolutions, including a FireBall
  • 8 savage new music tracks
  • 1 new adventure
  • 1 new very large stage
  • Interesting bits and bobs I won’t spoil at this time
But there’s more. Legacy of the Bloodmoon will cost approximately 1 money (0.99 USD), and Legacy of the Moonspell will receive a price cut and also be priced 1 money :) You can find all details about Legacy of the Bloodmoon below, now here’s a villainous trailer about it:

Vampire Survivors - First Survivaton

Among the many projects we’re working on (approximately 15 projects, not 15 games, please don’t panic) there is also a lineup of Survivaton games. It’s definitely a meaningful word that means “survive a ton” and nothing else. These are games like Vampire Survivors, developed internally at poncle, tied to IPs that might need unique game mechanics, a different graphic style, or are so expansive that ultimately deserve their own standalone game (compared to making a DLC for VS). I’d love to make examples, but I’d have to spoil way too much. Being developed internally, we’ll be able to guarantee affordability and worthwhile titles. Since a good 90% of global VS players aren’t reached by the Steam news (or are not interested in gaming news in general), the best way to also let them know that the Survivatons are tied directly to VS is to also call VS a Survivaton, hence the new sub-title. Please note there’s a dash before First Survivaton instead of a semi-colon, because DLCs exist... The next time I name a game I’ll remember to not use something as generic as “Monster Hunter” as inspiration please know I love Monster Hunter 💌

poncle Japan

We can finally say we are building poncle Japan! It will be poncle, but in Japan. The new studio is headed by Sawaki Takeyasu, known for his work on Devil May Cry, Ōkami, and El Shaddai: Ascension of the Metatron. Having a studio in Japan will simplify and speed up the work we do with all our Japanese partners, and also bring new opportunities for collabs. It’s too soon to say what the team will be working on; we are planning to fully open the studio by the end of 2026. Now it's time for all the FAQs and info blocks, thanks for reading and waiting patiently for this update! - Luca

Legacy of the Bloodmoon FAQs

When does it release? Summer 2026. What do you define as summer? Not winter. How much does it cost? Around £0.95, with regional pricing varying by platform and country. Why will Legacy of the Moonspell’s price change too? It felt right to adjust the price so that it’s more balanced compared to the amount of content of the other expansions. Please note that some stores have minimum prices in certain countries. In some places, Moonspell was already too cheap to make it cheaper. What about Tides of the Foscari then? Please at least wait for Moonspell and Bloodmoon before asking for more, we know we know 😭 Will Moonspell get new content too? Yes, 7 new unlocks for a few more weapons and characters. Is Vampire Survivors still getting free updates? Yes of course, there’s still plenty on the roadmap.

Update 1.15 Full spoilers

♫ Murder on the Seafloor Composed and arranged by Filippo Vicarelli.

Quick content guide:

  • Collect a total of 50 Vacuums to unlock The Lycaeum stage
  • Find the Penshin Fatcha in The Lycaeum and see all its evolutions to unlock it permanently
  • Survive 20 minutes in The Lycaeum to unlock Para Kooleo
  • Trigger a Lavatrix Machina with Para Kooleo to unlock Darkana VIII - Edge of the Earth
  • Buy the Survarocchi at the top of The Lycaeum to unlock them for any character
  • Buy the Green Eyes Vizard at the top of The Lycaeum to be able to find Bat Dragons in other stages
  • Defeat any Bat Dragon (Currently available in Mad Forest and Il Molise) to unlock the Unearthly Bolt wea;on
  • Evolve the Unearthly Bolt with a maxed Tirajisú to unlock Big Troubler
  • Defeat any Bat Dragon with Big Troubler and Arcana 0 - Game Killer to unlock Darkana 0 - Stake to your Heart
  • Survive 15 minutes in Inverse Boss Rash with Random Events and Random Level Ups to unlock Darkana XIX - Heir of Fate
  • Defeat 2 unique Bat Dragons to unlock a new set of Survarots to purchase from Big Troubler

Detailed info

New stage: The Lycaeum An underwater-themed stage where you press some buttons, beat some crabs, run to the center, kill more things, press more buttons, don’t die. The Drowner can only be defeated via raw damage or by reaching the top of the stage. Hidden treasures can be collected only using Mad Groove or Lavatrix Machina. Teleporters become active after reaching the top once. New character: Para Kooleo Starts with a Move Speed and Duration bonus. When his HP drops below a certain threshold it triggers a Vacuum. He also likes to evolve weapons. He has an abundance of skins. New character: Big Troubler Loves gold and gets trigger happy when he gets gold. The gold also loves him and will protect him at all costs. New weapon: Penshin Fatcha & Tonno Subito / Tonnado / Tonn’omoto / Tonn’oddeeo / Tonne / Unsurpassed / Miracle of Multiplication. Starting weapon for Para Kooleo. Select one of six tuna forms. Evolve it from one to another, stacking stats as you go. Evolve at least once to transform all the Vacuums pickup into "Lavatrix Machina". Then, if you choose to, evolve into the secret evolution, Miracle of Multiplication where everything happens at once. Does not require any items to evolve, but many, many treasure chests. New weapon: Unearthly Bolt & Spirit Disturbance Starting weapon of Big Troubler. Spawns green bolts that attack the closest enemy. It deals increasingly high damage if it Crits in rapid succession. The cap for this damage bonus is determined by Revivals. Evolve with a maxed out Tirajisú. The evolution spawns a green dragon that always deals critical hits. New relic: Green Eyes Vizard Bat Dragons will appear on the Stage Selection menu until they have been defeated at least once. They will appear on the map during a run, and they have to be activated by getting hit. Once active, time stops and enemy waves are changed until they are killed. You can fight them again in new runs, they simply won't be signaled in Stage Selection anymore after getting killed once. New Darkanas: 0 - Stake to your Heart Unlocked by defeating a Bat Dragon with Big Troubler while using the Game Killer Arcana. You will no longer be able to level up using experience gems. Instead, when defeating an enemy, they will also drop a Gold Coin, that you’ll be able to spend at a special merchant to buy weapons. Gold coins will also become your health: don't reach 0 (and quit before Red Death deals the usual 65535 damage per hit to you) New Darkanas: VIII - Edge of the Earth Unlocked by triggering a Lavatrix Machina with Para Kooleo. Gain Thorns and Move Speed locked at 200%, ignore walls, destroy light sources upon contact, and attract things that normally aren’t attracted by a Magnet, like treasure chests. New Darkanas: XIX - Heir of Fate Unlocked by surviving 15 minutes in inverse Boss Rash with Random Events and Random Level Ups enabled. While active, defeating enemies with Fire damage causes them to drop Scorched Souls. Additionally, a Nduja Fritta Tanto will trigger when the character's Health dips to a certain point. New Relics: Survarocchi Unlocked by purchasing it from the Big Troubler merchant in The Lycaeum. Allows Survarot cards to spawn from light sources. Previously available only via the Ante Chamber dlc and a secret character, Survarots Enemahs (Secret rather than Unlockable) Unlocked by purchasing it from the Big Troubler merchant in The Lycaeum after defeating any two unique Bat Dragons. Adds an extra 18 cards based on various enemies to drafts of Survarot. For the full list of bugfixes, please see here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1794680/view/693137145499484509

1.15 FAQs

How much is 1.15? It’s a free update. Can I now share DLCs when playing online? Not yet, in this patch we managed to do the groundwork to allow for DLC sharing, but we still have to complete the feature. Can I now use Cross-save on PS and Apple+? Not yet. We still don’t have the right policies in place to do that. What platforms is update 1.15 available on? Update 1.15 is launching on Steam first. Other platforms are planned to follow by the end of the month, including Xbox, PlayStation 4/5, Nintendo Switch, Android, iOS, and Epic Games Store. Is update 1.15 coming to Nintendo Switch 2? Yes! Update 1.15 will bring Vampire Survivors to Nintendo Switch 2 for the first time. It won’t arrive at the exact same time as the other platforms, but the current plan is for Nintendo Switch 2 support to follow around two weeks after update 1.15 (but don’t hold us to that). Where are the new achievements? We will sort out the new Steam achievements in the next patch (they will pop automatically). Hey are you still updating Vampire Crawlers? Yes of course, it’s taking longer than expected to release the first QOL improvements patch and a cute looking roadmap because we got stuck for days trying to exit the game.

items.title: Update 1.15 - list of fixes
items.summary: For the list of new content, please see here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1794680/view/693137145499484494 Memory usage optimization for low-end devices Improved audio system to stop music cutting out Reverted previous change so
items.content:
For the list of new content, please see here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1794680/view/693137145499484494
  • Memory usage optimization for low-end devices
  • Improved audio system to stop music cutting out
  • Reverted previous change so that Heart of Fire always deals retaliation damage
  • Improved startup speed when having many DLCs
  • Major optimization to enemy spawning
  • General memory and performance optimizations
  • Done some ground work to be able to share DLC in multiplayer in future patches (increased disk size of the game)
  • Restored original Lightning Ring projectile behavior
  • Restored original rendering of bird weapons, Prismatic Missile, Runetracer, and a few other
  • Minor Bestiary updates
  • Fixed Arch Angle not being able to crit by default
  • Fixed spells for Gracia's Mirror + Seventh Trumpet that could leave the unlocks incompletable
